negative_reviews.author: Lettie Lime
negative_reviews.text: I went in there at 20:40pm (06/07/26) My order was taken promptly and food was served quickly. When it was time for me to pay I had to go near the till to get someone's attention. I told the waitress that I have an NHS card. She proceeded to look at the card and said it doesn't have an expiry date. I've used this same card with no issues previously. Don't pick and choose when you'll accept NHS cards. I'm very disappointed in the way the situation was handled
